themes.label: Business growth
themes.definition: Loan grew an existing business or started or diversified into a new one: more stock, sales, customers, capital, or better harvests and livestock. Only for IMPACT03a (how life improved).

themes.label: Higher income
themes.definition: Income, earnings or profits rose, or the client has more money to spend or depends less on others, without naming a business mechanism. Only for IMPACT03a (how life improved).

themes.label: Household needs met
themes.definition: Loan helped cover everyday household needs: food, bills, consumption, health care or nutrition. Only for IMPACT03a (how life improved).

themes.label: Children's education
themes.definition: Loan paid school fees, uniforms, supplies or other education costs. Only for IMPACT03a (how life improved).

themes.label: Assets and housing
themes.definition: Loan bought durable assets (land, vehicles, equipment, cattle, goats, poultry or other animals bought or raised) or built, finished or repaired the home. Only for IMPACT03a (how life improved).

themes.label: Savings
themes.definition: Client can now save, or has more savings or financial security for the future. Only for IMPACT03a (how life improved).

themes.label: Less debt or stress
themes.definition: Loan reduced debts, money worries, or improved peace of mind and confidence. Only for IMPACT03a (how life improved).

themes.label: Broad improvement in living conditions
themes.definition: Names several gains together (food, housing, health, assets) or living conditions in general, with something concrete said. A bare 'it improved' goes to other. Only for IMPACT03a (how life improved).

themes.label: Expenses offset any gain
themes.definition: Life did not change because household costs, dependents or repayments used up what the loan brought, or no reason beyond 'no change'. Only for IMPACT03b (why life did not change).

themes.label: Too early to see an effect
themes.definition: Too little time has passed, the first harvest or cycle is not done, or the funds have not arrived yet. Only for IMPACT03b (why life did not change).

themes.label: Loan too small
themes.definition: The loan amount was too small to make a difference. For IMPACT03b or IMPACT03c.

themes.label: Economic or external conditions
themes.definition: Inflation, cost of living, competition, low buyer prices, pests, disease or weather limited the benefit or made things worse. For IMPACT03b or IMPACT03c.

themes.label: Business setback
themes.definition: The business declined, failed, or lost stock or assets (theft, mismanagement), or the client says life or business got worse without a reason. Only for IMPACT03c (how life got worse).

themes.label: Illness or family emergency
themes.definition: Illness, death or a family emergency caused hardship or used up the loan. Only for IMPACT03c (how life got worse).

themes.label: Repayment stress
themes.definition: Struggle, stress or a cycle of hardship from repaying the loan. Only for IMPACT03c (how life got worse).

themes.label: Loan used or given for a different purpose
themes.definition: The loan received did not match the purpose asked for, or was spent on personal needs rather than the business, so the plan was not realised. For IMPACT03b or IMPACT03c.
